notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: no human review, no hardware run and no sim run. The upstream repository is not a standalone package: README.md:40-70 copies its files into ManiSkill and README.md:7-8 needs ManiSkill 3.x and SAPIEN 3.x, which were not installed; package code never imports the clone, so fake.py is the package's own task-level Python model of ArrayCanEnv. The card prefers the upstream simulator (mock_strategy upstream-sim); that path was not available and was not run. Only the catalogue classes cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. NOT COVERED: the full action and observation arrays, the Panda arm and gripper, SAPIEN contacts and dynamics, and the camera images. The upstream action_space and observation_space are inherited from ManiSkill's BaseEnv and the Panda agent, which are external to the clone and not stated in it; the fake deliberately exposes neither, so the bridge publishes the step action as an open object with no shape or bounds instead of an invented limit. The fidelity is F0 with timestep_ms 0 because the clone does not state ManiSkill's control period; seeded determinism uses Python's random.Random while ManiSkill uses torch's RNG. Risk is R0 because every bound class is R0 and the device is simulated; the Panda arm exists only inside the upstream simulation and this package has no hardware backend. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge seed is bookkeeping and makes no native call), G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x3 for reset/step/close (they come from the external BaseEnv and occur in the clone), G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE (no driver limit on an actuating capability; the clone states no action bound) and G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the integer ticks and seed inputs the bridge derives. The upstream licence is NOASSERTION/unknown and nothing was installed. gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run. The clone was not modified.
